citation: Y. Mishin (2004), 'Atomistic modeling of the gamma and gamma'-phases of the Ni-Al system', Acta Materialia 52(6), 1451-1467.
fitting_scope: Ni-Al potential developed primarily for the gamma (Ni solid solution) and gamma-prime (Ni3Al) phases; fitted to experimental and first-principles data for lattice properties, point defects, planar faults, and phase-diagram characteristics; narrower intended composition scope than the 2009 general binary potential.
implementation_notes: Only the corrected ipr2 implementation is accepted for this project. Project formation energies are still calculated from consistently relaxed bulk elemental references, never from isolated atoms.
known_warnings: The superseded ipr1 implementation (NiAl.eam.alloy) must not be used; it has non-zero isolated-atom energies.

superseded_ipr1.rejection_reason: The ipr1 file has non-zero isolated-atom energies: bulk potential energies are correct but do not correspond to cohesive energies. The corrected ipr2 file explicitly sets the zero-density embedding value F(rho=0)=0 so isolated atoms have zero energy.

comment_lines: NiAl (L12) EAM from Y. Mishin, Acta Mat. 52, 1451-1467 (2004).
This is a reimplementation by Lucas Hale based on cubic spline interpolations of Yuri Mishin's plt files.
Specifically, this version explicitly sets F(0)=0 to ensure energies of isolated atoms are 0.0.
